status: validated (機械検証合格 2026-11-05; パイロット承認済みの方針で作成)

segments.t: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God.
Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.
segments.note: τὸν γεννήσαντα（生ませた方）を「the Father」と訳す。「who is」は英語の補い

segments.t: By this we know that we love the children of God,
when we love God and keep his commandments.
segments.note: ποιῶμεν（行う）を「keep」と訳す

segments.t: For this is loving God,
segments.note: ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ（神の愛）を「loving God」と動詞化する

segments.t: that we keep his commandments.
His commandments are not grievous.
segments.note: καὶ（13番）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world.
This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.
segments.note: καὶ（11番）は英語に現れないので対応なし。ἡμῶν（私たちの）を WEB が「your」と訳す

segments.t: Who is he who overcomes the world,
segments.note: δὲ（2番）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
segments.note: 「but」は εἰ μὴ（〜でなければ）の表現

segments.t: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ;
not with the water only, but with the water and the blood.
segments.note: 「with」は ἐν の訳

segments.t: It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
segments.note: 「It is the Spirit who」は τὸ πνεῦμά ἐστιν τὸ μαρτυροῦν の分裂文化

segments.t: For there are three who testify:
segments.note: 「there」は存在表現の補い。なお WEB の本節には Comma Johanneum（父・御言・聖霊の句）は含まれない

segments.t: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.
segments.note: εἰς τὸ ἕν εἰσιν（一つへとある）を「agree as one」と訳す

segments.t: If we receive the witness of men,
segments.note: 主語の「we」はギリシャ語動詞に含まれる

segments.t: the witness of God is greater;
for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.
segments.note: 後半の ὅτι 節を関係節化。主語の「he」は英語の補い

segments.t: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself.
He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar,
segments.note: 不定冠詞「a」は英語の補い

segments.t: because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.
segments.note: μεμαρτύρηκεν（証しした）を「has given（testimony）」とほぐす

segments.t: The testimony is this:
segments.note: καὶ（1番）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: that God gave to us eternal life,
and this life is in his Son.
He who has the Son has the life.
He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.
These things I have written to you
segments.note: 主語の「I」はギリシャ語動詞に含まれる

segments.t: who believe in the name of the Son of God,
segments.note: τοῖς πιστεύουσιν（信じる者たちに）という ὑμῖν への同格を関係節化

segments.t: that you may know that you have eternal life,
and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: This is the boldness which we have toward him,
segments.note: καὶ（1番）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
segments.note: 主語の「he」は ἀκούει に含まれる。「listens to」は ἀκούει＋属格の表現

segments.t: And if we know that he listens to us,
whatever we ask,
we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death,
segments.note: 不定冠詞「a」は英語の補い

segments.t: he shall ask, and God will give him life
segments.note: 主語の「he」は αἰτήσει に、「God」は δώσει の主語として補われる

segments.t: for those who sin not leading to death.
segments.note: 「for」は τοῖς の与格の表出

segments.t: There is sin leading to death.
segments.note: 「There is」は存在表現の補い

segments.t: I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.
segments.note: 主語の「he」は ἐρωτήσῃ に含まれる

segments.t: All unrighteousness is sin,
and there is sin not leading to death.
segments.note: 「leading」は πρὸς の含みとして補われる

segments.t: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin,
but he who was born of God keeps himself,
segments.note: αὐτόν を再帰的に「himself」と訳す

segments.t: and the evil one doesn’t touch him.
We know that we are of God,
and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.
segments.note: 「the power of」は ἐν τῷ πονηρῷ（悪しき者のうちに）の補い

segments.t: We know that the Son of God has come
segments.note: δὲ（2番）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: and has given us an understanding,
segments.note: 不定冠詞「an」は英語の補い

segments.t: that we know him who is true;
and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ.
This is the true God and eternal life.
Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
